decisions.Kwic: 拈云：「若作佛法商量，累他石門眉毛墮落。」

Decision.AttributionNote: 南海寶象林慧弓詗禪師語錄, comment on an old case. Huigong Xiong is the exact commenting speaker: he says that discussing the case as buddha-dharma would implicate Shimen and make Shimen's eyebrows fall out.
